description: This file defines a command class 'DauxCommand' for the Symfony Console component, used to configure and prepare documentation processing in the Daux tool. It specifies command-line options and methods to set up configuration and processor instances.

classes.name: DauxCommand
classes.description: Defines a Symfony console command for configuring and preparing the Daux documentation generator.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command-line options for the console command.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Creates and configures a ConfigBuilder instance based on command-line options.

methods.name: prepareProcessor
methods.description: Initializes the Daux processor class with the given width.
